catalog_description: Typed key-value data tied to a running process instance, carrying the business payload that steps read and write as work advances.
Distinct execution patterns found in a process event log, grouping cases that follow significantly different paths, with their frequency and cycle time.
As-built records of manufactured items, with serial number, lot or batch, the order that produced them, and quality status, forming the traceability backbone.
Reusable package definitions that group products together with selection rules and bundled-discount pricing.
Declarations stating whether a controlled substance is present in a part, at what concentration, and whether a regulatory exemption applies.
Captured user selections when configuring a quote line, mapping chosen options on a base product to a specific variant.
Capabilities, stories, or epics on a product roadmap, the atomic unit for prioritization and mapping customers to releases.
Launch records for a product or feature, tracking tier, key dates, status, and the post-launch retrospective.
Software product lines in development and go-to-market, bundling features and releases across their lifecycle.
Product key performance indicators tracked over time, such as adoption, retention, usage, and churn risk.
Versioned software releases that bundle a set of features and define the delivery date and scope.
Timeline views of planned features grouped by release, product, or theme.
Shop-floor equipment or line stoppages, with start time, duration, reason code, throughput impact, and resolution, feeding equipment effectiveness metrics.
Units of work released to the factory floor, specifying product, quantity, schedule window, build instructions, and material requirements.
Inspection results for a produced unit or batch, recording checklist completion, pass or fail, defect classification, and inspector.
Published build plans for a line, cell, or workcenter, with time-based slots, assigned orders, sequencing, and changeover windows.
Summary statistics computed on a data asset during a scan, such as cardinality, null percentage, distinct count, and value distributions.
Fixed timeboxes during which a release train delivers incremental value, planned in a big-room event and closed with an inspect-and-adapt review.
Allocations of a worker to a project, with role, bill rate, cost rate, planned hours, and period, driving utilization and availability reporting.
Discrete billing triggers within a project, with amount, trigger condition, and status, driving revenue recognition and invoicing on fixed-fee work.
Forward-looking plans committing resources to projects, with skill, planned utilization, and effective period, distinct from executed assignments.
Decomposed units of work within a project, with scope, dependencies, estimated hours, and status, used for time tracking and earned-value calculation.
Markup comments placed on a region of a proof during review, with the reviewer, location, and resolution state.
Review-and-approval cycles on a creative asset or document, where reviewers mark up the proof and decide to approve or request changes.
Buyer-side lease contracts for real estate, covering terms, dates, financials, and renewals, with lease accounting under ASC 842 and IFRS 16.
Allocable units within a property such as desks, meeting rooms, parking spaces, or lockers.
People or households occupying a rental unit under a lease, with contact details, lease history, payment history, and screening results.
Periodic valuations of a property or portfolio by cap rate, discounted cash flow, or comparison, with valuation date, method, and assumptions.
Proposed code changes targeting a branch in a source repository, with author, branches, status, reviewers, approvals, and continuous-integration results.
A library of survey items rotated through pulse-survey cadences, with driver mapping, anti-fatigue rotation, and benchmarking.
Records of sewage pump-outs for a vessel, kept for Clean Vessel Act grant reporting and state mandates.
Orders issued to a supplier authorizing delivery, with line items, agreed prices, delivery terms, payment terms, and ship-to and bill-to details.
Internal requests to buy something, capturing what is needed, the requester, justification, budget reference, and approval state.
Work items raised when a data quality rule is breached, with root-cause detail, remediation status, linked data assets, and SLA.
Rules defining acceptable data state, such as cardinality bounds, regex patterns, referential integrity, and statistical thresholds.
Audit trail of executed queries, linking metric reads back to source tables, transformations, and the requesting identity.
Reusable pools of assessment questions independent of any single test, drawn from for randomized quizzes and recertification exams.
Real-time and historical metrics per contact queue, such as wait time, abandonment rate, service level, and average handle time.
Item-level learner responses to quiz questions, captured for per-question review and psychometric analysis.
Revenue targets allocated to a territory, rep, or team for a plan period.
Line- and quote-level discounts, recording the source, amount, and approval status.
Individual lines on a quote for a configured product, with unit price, quantity, line total, bundle nesting, and discounts.
Pre-agreed bill rates by role, geography, and supplier tier, driving consistent work-order pricing and accounts-payable matching.
Templates of cross-functional readiness items a launch must clear before going live.
Properties offered for sale or rent, with pricing, photos, descriptions, agent representation, and status from active to sold.
Buildings, facilities, or managed spaces, owned or leased, tracked across their lifecycle from acquisition to sale or expiry.
Real estate deals from accepted offer through close, with parties, terms, contingencies, escrow timeline, and document compliance.
Aggregated session telemetry for an end-user device over a window, covering page loads, app launches, network quality, and connectivity transitions.
Records of a product recall execution, with affected lots, notification log, hold-and-segregate status, and regulatory filing.
Recurrence configurations that drive periodic compliance-refresh assignment cycles for regulations like FINRA, HIPAA, and OSHA.
Legal hold and disposition rules per document class, with regulatory retention periods and scheduled destruction dates.
Free-text recruiter notes attached to a candidate, application, or talent pool, time-stamped and authored by a user.
Saved recruiter searches over the candidate database, with the filter expression, last-run time, and alert preferences.
Links between candidates and recruiting events, recording registration, check-in, attendance, and conversion outcome.
Third-party recruiters and staffing firms supplying candidates, with contract terms, contacts, performance, and submitted candidates.
Career fairs, campus events, hackathons, and meetups used as sourcing channels, tracking attendees, captured leads, and event return.
Channels a candidate came from, such as job board, referral, agency, campaign, or inbound, used for source-of-hire and channel analytics.
Scheduled charges generated from a contract, such as dockage, storage, or service fees billed on a periodic cadence.
Catalog entries for loyalty rewards, with point values, redemption eligibility rules, and partner-offer linkage.
Fulfillments of a loyalty reward redemption, covering point deduction, reward shipment, and partner settlement.
Time-bounded promotions offering bonus referral rewards, scoping an override to the standard referral payout rules.
Individual referral payouts triggered when a referred candidate is hired and meets tenure conditions, moving from pending to approved to paid.
Bounty rules defining the payout amount and conditions for a successful referral, such as a fixed sum paid after the new hire's start.
Reference catalog of substances controlled by product regulations, with CAS number, regulation pointers, threshold concentrations, and exemptions.
Export artifacts prepared for regulator submissions, such as OSHA 300 logs, FINRA filings, and state rollups.
Government-assessed fees for permits, licenses, inspections, and citations, with fee type, amount, due date, payer, and payment status.
Notifications received from a regulator, with jurisdiction, inquiry type, subject, deadline, assigned counsel, and response status.
Graph edges capturing relationships between people, organizations, and the firm, such as introductions, co-investor ties, and advisor links.
Action plans to close an issue or failed control test, with responsible party, target date, steps, evidence requirements, and status.
Configured nudge cadences that drive automated reminders to learners and managers.
Remote-control sessions, with technician, target endpoint, attended or unattended type, timestamps, transferred files, and recording link.
Tenant payments of rent or other lease charges, with amount, allocation across charges, late fees, and reconciliation status.
Prospective-tenant applications with personal and financial details, employer info, references, and screening results, preceding lease signing.
Residential lease agreements between landlord and tenant for a rental unit, covering term, rent schedule, security deposit, and addenda.
Lettable units within a residential property, such as apartments or condos, with amenities, size, current rent, and lease status.
Many-to-many links between product requirements and the test cases that verify them, supporting coverage metrics and impact analysis.
Approval steps that gate opening a job requisition, each recording the approver, decision, timestamp, and rationale.
Assignments of a person, team, or asset to an initiative or roadmap item for a period, with utilization and cost rate.
An inventory of skills and competencies across the resource base, with proficiency levels, used to forecast utilization.
Retail store labor schedules covering shift assignments, associate availability, and coverage, with retail-specific staffing logic.
Return merchandise authorizations created for a customer return, with refund status, return location, and tracking.
Period revenue forecast snapshots by segment and roll-up, recording the committed, best-case, and pipeline calls for a forecast period.
Deferred-revenue schedules under ASC 606 and IFRS 15, with performance obligations, allocations, recognition timeline, and recognized versus deferred amounts.
Pre-hire right-to-work verification events, such as the I-9 or E-Verify check, recording method, status, verifier, and outcome under employment-eligibility law.
Periodic or event-driven exercises to identify, analyze, and evaluate risks, with type, scope, date, register version, and findings.
Configured behavioral indicators or detection rules that add weight to user risk scores and fire alerts, such as large downloads before resignation.
Installed monitoring-and-management agents on endpoints and servers, with version, last check-in, health, configuration state, and telemetry status.
Planned product or capability deliveries slated for a future release cycle, with dependencies and contingency planning.
Reservations of meeting rooms, event spaces, or collaborative areas by an employee or team, with time slot, capacity, and requested amenities.
Root cause analysis records, suggested or human-confirmed, linking candidate causes to the correlated event cluster and resulting incident.
Right-of-use assets recognized for a lease, with initial measurement, accumulated amortization, impairment, and carrying value under ASC 842 or IFRS 16.
Discrete UI-level actions within a bot, such as click, type, extract, wait, or branch, sequenced to form the bot logic.
Per-execution traces of individual bot activities, with sequence, status, optional screenshot, captured data, timestamp, and error details.
Stored secrets used by bots, with credential type, target system, encrypted value, and rotation policy.
Automation bot definitions that drive UI-level interactions, with process logic, trigger conditions, error handling, and version history.
Versioned, distributable bot packages, with release notes, checksum, target environment, and deployment details.
Single runs of a bot, with start and end time, status, execution log, input variables, and output results.
Recurring bot execution configurations, with cron frequency, timezone, enabled state, next run time, and log retention policy.
